body:
## Summary
- reset the labyrinth grenade tutorial back to the first step when grenade preparation is canceled before the throw
- allow the tutorial strikethrough animation to move backward so the crossed-out segment clears correctly
- add a focused GUT regression test covering the canceled grenade-prep flow

## Reproduction
1. Start the labyrinth level tutorial.
2. Hold the first grenade combo step (`G+ПКМ вправо`) until the first segment is crossed out.
3. Release the input early instead of finishing the throw.
4. Before this fix, the tutorial stayed partially completed instead of returning to the initial state.

## Verification
- Added `tests/unit/test_labyrinth_grenade_tutorial.gd` to reproduce the canceled-prep case.
- Local automated execution could not be completed in this environment because `godot` is not installed (`/bin/bash: line 1: godot: command not found`).

Fixes #1817
